title: Luxury Downtown 2 bed 2 bath corner unit- #304
description:
Luxurious  Condo has open floor plan with upscale furnishings, granite counter tops and stainless steel appliances, floor to ceiling windows giving you a spectacular view of Music City.
It features a master bedroom with king bed, guest bedroom  with a queen bed, and a queen sofa sleeper in the living room which will accommodate up to six guests.  This 1200 square foot spacious retreat located on the third floor is in the perfect location to experience all of Music City 
2 free parking spaces

Guest access
Guests will have access to the building amenities including the workout room, and rooftop terrace, rec building and one spot in parking garage.

Other things to note
Unit Amenities
1100 sq ft Brand 2 Bedroom, 2 Full Baths, Queen Sleeper Sofa- TV’s in both bedrooms.
Private Balcony
